card.line: Rimmon is the name of a few places in the Bible. The best known is a rock where 600 men of Benjamin hid and were later offered peace.

moments.title: Benjamites flee to the rock
moments.text: After the battle with Israel, the Benjamites ran toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon. Israel cut down thousands on the roads, but 600 men reached the rock and stayed there four months.

moments.title: A message of peace
moments.text: The whole congregation sent a message of peace to the Benjamites at the rock of Rimmon. Then the Benjamites returned and were given the women spared from Jabesh-gilead.

moments.title: A city given to Simeon
moments.text: Rimmon is listed among the cities in Judah's land. It was also named among the cities of Simeon, whose inheritance was taken from Judah's portion because Judah's share was too large.
